label_provenance.tool: ffmpeg source-frame sheets with ffprobe timestamp index
notes: Gate judgments were made independently from the source frames; the legacy global clean field was not adapted into gate passes.
The 10 FPS diagnostic pose export was used only to confirm phase observability and suggest frames for visual review; no pose threshold classified a gate.
Event-onset frames are the first visually discernible descent frames and carry medium timing confidence because initial motion is subtle.
This is an AI-assisted prelabel and requires independent human gate-by-gate confirmation before it counts as ground truth.

tempo_control_definition.description: Judge visible control independently from phase duration; a fast rep is not automatically a failure.
pass_criteria: Descent and ascent remain visibly intentional without a judged loss of control.
fail_criteria: A visible collapse, uncontrolled bounce, or uncontrolled direction change occurs.
unknown_criteria: Occlusion, framing, playback quality, or missing frames prevent a reliable judgment.
